Title: Azure Cosmos DB recommendations keep you on the right track

Body.Content:
Azure Cosmos DB gets updated frequently, so to make it easier to stay up-to-date, we’ve introduced automatic and tailored recommendations for all Azure Cosmos DB users. Recommendations—from upgrading SDK versions to migrating fixed containers to partitioned ones—now appear in the Azure portal when you browse your Azure Cosmos DB accounts.

There are three ways to find your Cosmos DB recommendations:

  1. Click on this message at the top of the Cosmos DB blade:
  2. Head directly to the "Notifications" section of your Cosmos DB account:
  3. Find them through Azure Advisor.

We'll continue to expand the coverage of these notifications to include topics like partitioning, indexing, network security and much more. If you have suggestions for more recommendations, email us.
